description: Change a rule's name, what it looks at (send scope, conditions and window TOGETHER — Meta replaces the whole evaluation), its action and/or its schedule. Never changes whether it is on (set_meta_ad_rule_status does). IF THE RULE IS ON and the new version can raise spend, this takes confirm:true plus confirmScope for the NEW version and is checked against the account caps: an edit is never a way round the switch-on gate. The answer is Meta's stored rule, read back. Free.

by.description: exactly one of percent or amount

amount.description: in the currency base unit (cents for USD)

change.description: increase or decrease, for budget/bid. Meta has no "set to"

level.description: campaign for a campaign budget (CBO); otherwise the ad set budget

limit.description: REQUIRED for an increase: the ceiling (base unit, 5000 = $50.00). A floor for a decrease. [low, high] with targetField

maxTimes.description: the most times this action may run in all (execution_count_limit)

minMinutesBetween.description: Meta's action_frequency: minutes before the same object is changed again; default 1440 (once a day)

targetField.description: scale the budget/bid toward a target metric instead (Meta's target_field), e.g. cost_per_result

type.description: pause, enable (switch back on), notify, budget or bid

userIds.description: Meta user ids to notify; default is the connection's user

adAccountId.description: Meta ad account id (act_… or the bare number) from list_meta_ads; required — every rule lives on one ad account

field.description: any Meta rule filter field, as Meta spells it: spent, cost_per, cpa, cpc, cpm, ctr, results, impressions, frequency, website_purchase_roas, mobile_app_purchase_roas, cost_per_purchase_fb, cost_per_lead_fb, today_spent, yesterday_spent, lifetime_spent, daily_budget, hours_since_creation …

operator.description: GREATER_THAN, LESS_THAN, EQUAL, NOT_EQUAL, IN_RANGE, NOT_IN_RANGE, IN, NOT_IN, CONTAIN, NOT_CONTAIN

value.description: a number, or [low, high] for IN_RANGE. MONEY IS IN THE CURRENCY BASE UNIT: for USD 1000 = $10.00

confirm.description: true once the user has said yes to exactly what the refusal described

confirmScope.description: the scopeToken the list tool (or the refusal) prints; required with confirm when the rule can raise spend

evaluationSpec.description: advanced: Meta's raw evaluation_spec, passed through as given (overrides the plain fields)

executionSpec.description: advanced: Meta's raw execution_spec, passed through as given (overrides the plain fields)

schedule.description: how often Meta checks it (schedule rules)

startMinute.description: minutes after midnight, account time, multiple of 30

scheduleSpec.description: advanced: Meta's raw schedule_spec, passed through as given (overrides the plain fields)

scope.description: what the rule looks at: level or ids (Meta requires one)

adsetIds.description: only ads under these ad sets

ids.description: a FIXED list of campaign, ad set or ad ids instead of a level

level.description: campaign, adset or ad: every object at that level, INCLUDING ones created later (Meta re-resolves it each run)

nameContains.description: only objects whose name contains this

trigger.description: makes it a TRIGGER rule Meta checks in real time (no schedule; pause/enable/notify only)

type.description: METADATA_CREATION, METADATA_UPDATE, STATS_CHANGE, STATS_MILESTONE or DELIVERY_INSIGHTS_CHANGE

window.description: time window for the metrics: TODAY, YESTERDAY, LAST_3_DAYS, LAST_7_DAYS, LAST_14_DAYS, LAST_30_DAYS, LIFETIME, THIS_MONTH …

name: update_meta_ad_rule
title: Change a Meta automated rule
